clause: The hunt does not stop when a branch fails; it takes another branch. Where no branch exists, one is built
quote: Where no automated branch reaches a body, the session hand-works it — that is the job, not a fallback — and the branch it builds becomes project property inherited by every later body, ZIP and state.

clause: Independence is counted over distinct dependencies, not branch names; two routes failing for the same reason are one route wearing two names
restoreText: Branch independence is counted over distinct dependencies, never branch names: two routes that fail for the same reason are one route wearing two names, and an absence argued from them is void.
reason: R-0250 asserts branches to the same fact are independent but never gives the anti-collusion counting rule. The corpus carries no proof-standard collapsing same-cause failures, so a VERIFIED_ABSENT could be earned from routes that all failed for one reason — the exact gaming this rule forbids.

clause: Staleness is a state the data carries, not a note in a document
quote: A record that cannot say when it was measured reads as stale.

clause: The RULING 58 independence test is NOT superseded — still how branches are counted
restoreText: Branch independence is counted over distinct dependencies, never branch names; two routes failing for the same reason are one route, and this is how branches are counted toward exhaustion.
reason: Same missing obligation as R-0052's independence clause: the distinct-dependency counting rule that governs how many independent branches an absence rests on is carried nowhere in the active corpus. R-0250's 'branches are independent' asserts the property without defining how it is counted.

clause: The manifest only grows and applies retroactively: every absence stamps the manifest version it was earned under, so adding a route re-opens every absence earned under the old version automatically
quote: A new validated method reopens prior conclusions earned before it existed, and flags every dependent assertion for revalidation.

clause: A route is never removed; one that stops working keeps its id with a dated note
quote: Every eligible edge persists with a stable id, provenance and disposition; the cursor is explicit; restart never recrawls seeds to rediscover what was known.

clause: A route a non-technical person reaches in two clicks is Tier A by definition and is added to the manifest the moment it is found
quote: Every hunt report carries an EXPANSION section listing routes that did not exist at session start — how each was conceived, what it returned, where else it applies, and whether it was recorded.

clause: 'Nothing further' is an assertion of exhaustion and is PROHIBITED; the item fails; a session that cannot think of another thing has found the limit of its imagination (a fact about the session, not the government)
quote: No number of attempts earns an absence, and a protocol that terminates is not persistence.

clause: The META-SEARCH is a FIRST MOVE, not a last resort: before touching any individual entity, ask where the state/county publishes officials; one cheap search beats hundreds
quote: A body found only by per-entity search when the tier above was never asked is a coverage defect.

clause: A wall is a wall AROUND something: the record states what the wall is around and what other road reaches it
quote: A walled host is never evidence that a body is unreachable.

clause: Every AUTHENTICATED resource is walked before any UNAUTHENTICATED one is exhausted; a key sitting unused while hitting a public rate limit is a DEFECT and is reported as one
quote: Every key in `.env.local` is a Tier A route and is walked; a paid source going unwalked while a free one rate-limits is a defect.

clause: The instrument is shown catching the real instance; a sweep that cannot find the defect it was written for is reporting green about nothing; the test carries the shipped copy verbatim
quote: the auditor is itself scored by the control set: its catch rate on planted defects is reported beside its findings.

clause: Each wall names what it is a wall AROUND
quote: A walled host is never evidence that a body is unreachable.

clause: An absence built ENTIRELY of walls is recorded as such and must be legible as the weakest kind; VERIFIED_ABSENT is still RULING 61's bar and is NOT reached this way
quote: A CAPTCHA is not absence. Missing tooling is not absence. A walled host is never evidence that a body is unreachable.

clause: A session that has exhausted its ideas says 'I have run out of ideas' (a claim about the session) rather than 'this is not published' (a claim about the government)
quote: Absence is never asserted; a wall never renders as an emptiness.

clause: Any cap in any brief (five moves, N routes, a list of seven) is a FLOOR; a brief that appears to cap effort is misdrafted and the session says so
quote: The subject universe may be bounded; the method never is. A workstream may have a denominator. The effort permitted to complete an owed item is not capped.

clause: The productive question is 'WHO WAS COMPELLED TO WRITE THIS DOWN?' — municipal code, tax-rate tables, legal notices, budgets, audits, minutes of the tier above, annual reports, state oversight directories
reason: The stuck protocol survives in R-0250 as an explicitly non-exhaustive opening ('Five moves ... they are the opening, not the count'), and its move 4 already carries the secondary-custodian heuristic ('Who else needed this badly enough to have compiled it — courts, local news, the League of Women Voters, unions, chambers, libraries, universities'). The statutory-compulsion variant and its document list are method-knowledge elaboration that lives in history and the method store, not a distinct binding bar.

clause: If a session has no further avenue it says 'I have run out of ideas' (a claim about the session), never 'the government does not publish this' (a claim about a government)
quote: Absence is never asserted; a wall never renders as an emptiness.

clause: Coverage is measured against the OFFICIAL universe — the Census of Governments, NCES, and the state registers that enumerate the twigs the Census misses
restoreText: Coverage of the smallest bodies is also measured against the state registers that enumerate the twigs the Census of Governments and NCES miss.
reason: R-0251 narrows the external coverage anchor to 'the Census of Governments and NCES' and itself concedes 'those sources establish governments and districts, never governing bodies.' It names no denominator for the small bodies those sources omit. R-0057 added state registers precisely to catch the villages and water districts the Census misses, so the narrowing leaves the smallest-body coverage denominator carried nowhere.

clause: Two official enumerations that disagree is a FINDING, not an error: the body is named with both facts recorded rather than dropped because two authorities could not agree it exists
restoreText: Two official enumerations that disagree is a finding, not an error: the body is named with both facts recorded, never dropped because two authorities could not agree it exists.
reason: R-0251 covers external checking and that a reconciled total is not a correct one, but is silent on what to do when two authorities disagree about a body's existence. The rule that such a body is kept and named with both facts recorded — never dropped — is carried nowhere, and dropping it would be an asserted absence for exactly the small bodies R-0251 exists to name.

clause: A count is per LEVEL, per STATE, never one number for a run (a run total hides the level that returned nothing)
quote: A partial source is a first-class result that says which scope failed and why, and carry-forward preserves that scope and no other.

clause: The number that says whether the descent WORKED is bodies discovered that were not already in the registry; every other column measures effort
quote: Coverage rises only through verified, promoted bodies, and no candidate count may substitute for the promoted-body count.

clause: The walk states its PASS COUNT and the final pass's new-link count; if the final pass found anything new, the walk was not finished and the session says so
quote: CONVERGED_AS_OF means every currently eligible avenue has a disposition under the current method, universe and eligibility versions on that date — never that no other source exists.

clause: Zero at a tier FAILS LOUDLY; zero counties in a US state is a broken walk, never a finding
quote: A zero-row extraction is a failed extraction, never an empty document.

clause: Detector counts require calibration against what the detector actually found; tests include false-positive calibration, not merely non-zero output; a detector must not be able to satisfy a success threshold entirely with known false positives
quote: Coverage rises only through verified, promoted bodies, and no candidate count may substitute for the promoted-body count.

clause: A workstream is COMPLETE_AS_OF only when its owed universe is defined, every member accounted for exactly once, every required child has an allowed disposition, no UNKNOWN remains, no owed item is represented absent because of a blocker, the eligible graph has converged for the freshness window, and it is stamped with the method version
quote: Convergence is versioned. CONVERGED_AS_OF means every currently eligible avenue has a disposition under the current method, universe and eligibility versions on that date — never that no other source exists. Completion is derived from child state.

clause: A derived frontier index may be regenerated from canonical edge state; if canonical outstanding work exists only because a future crawl will rediscover it, it is not persisted
quote: A frontier is state, not a recipe for recreating state. Every eligible edge persists with a stable id, provenance and disposition; the cursor is explicit; restart never recrawls seeds to rediscover what was known.

clause: UNVALIDATED is a permitted validation state; SILENCE is not, because silence reads as though the claim had been checked
quote: A check that cannot run says so. Silence is not a passing result; the suite asserts checks registered equal checks reporting.

clause: Dependence is declared, never inferred from text (a text match between two similar sentences is a guess, not a mechanism)
quote: Any interface between independently built lanes is one shared typed schema imported by both sides and proven by a compatibility test that runs the real producer into the real consumer; a paragraph is not a contract.

clause: Every new or amended entry declares its class; entries predating adoption are reported UNCLASSIFIED by number, which does not mean they carry no conclusion
quote: Four assertion classes, distinct burdens: `ROUTE_EXISTENCE`, `ROUTE_OUTCOME`, `COVERAGE_CLAIM`, `DERIVED_CONCLUSION`.

clause: An amendment adds no avenue and bumps no method version, so classifying or correcting an entry can never mechanically reopen conclusions as though something had been discovered
quote: A new validated method reopens prior conclusions earned before it existed, and flags every dependent assertion for revalidation.

clause: Duplicate-id protection against TODAY'S populated store is not protection, because the protection disappears exactly when the store does (empty-store re-seed danger)
quote: Every production-serving source tenant's `bodyId` resolves to exactly one canonical registered body of the correct jurisdiction; an adapter never mints a body.

clause: Where a clause NARROWS, it narrows the clause it is written beside and nothing wider; the chosen reading is recorded next to it together with the rejected wider readings and why
reason: The scope-of-narrowing concern is carried by R-0272's authority precedence (a delegated or narrower clause never overrides wider law; a conflict is represented, not resolved by whichever document was read last) and by R-0247 (a consolidated or narrowing restatement may change no obligation, bar or proof standard). Recording the chosen and rejected readings is interpretive documentation elaboration, not a distinct binding obligation.

clause: A contract may only ever TIGHTEN what closes an obligation; naming an open disposition in an acceptable-dispositions list does not make it terminal, and the evaluator still refuses it as outstanding
quote: `docs/report-contract.md` is the close-out contract every hunt answers. A brief may add to it and never subtract.

clause: An Attempt refused a capability mid-execution leaves the RouteTask POLICY_DENIED — OUTSTANDING, never disposed, never a plain reclaim inviting an identical retry; it records what must change before a retry
quote: A policy denial is a fact about the policy, not the record.

clause: An escalation created without an opinion BLOCKS; a field nobody set must never be the reason an obligation closed
quote: A row may not enter Needs Sean without either a machine-verifiable predicate rechecked on every tracker generation that auto-resolves the row when it goes false, or an explicit `NOT_MACHINE_VERIFIABLE` marking carrying a decision card stating what is needed, the options, the consequence of each, and the row's age.

clause: The write carries an optimistic-concurrency precondition; a writer that read version N refuses to overwrite a store now at N+1, naming both; there is no last-writer-wins path
quote: the integration owner alone reconciles the shared stores — canonical work state, the tracker, state and log, the method store — and regenerates every generated artifact once.
